# Analytics Vidhya

> > Analytics Vidhya is a leading data science and analytics community platform providing educational content, career resources, and insights on Python, SQL, Tableau, machine learning, NLP, generative AI, LLMs, and emerging technologies like RAG and LangChain.

Analytics Vidhya serves as a comprehensive resource hub for data science professionals and learners across India and globally. The platform features tutorials, career opportunities, and industry insights covering the full spectrum of analytics, from traditional business intelligence to cutting-edge generative AI applications.

## Key Topics

- Data Science
- Machine Learning
- Python
- SQL
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Generative AI
- Large Language Models (LLM)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- ChatGPT
- LangChain
- Tableau
- Business Intelligence
- Big Data
- Analytics Career Development
- Deep Learning
